Dissolved ferrous iron Fe(II) concentration in porewater

Iron concentration data quality flag.NS indicates that there was no sample to analyze either because there was no sample or because there was not enough sample. SL indicates that the sample was lost, e.g. due to spillage or a container breaking. C indicates that the value should be used with caution, e.g. because of a difference in sample storage or preservation to the other samples, a cracked container, and/or the value being outside a previously observed range. BD indicates that the value is bellow detection but above 0. BD_Z indicates that based on the standard curve, the estimated value was negative and has been set to 0. X_ACC indicates that the QA/QC targets for accuracy for that value were exceeded. X_PREC indicates that the QA/QC targets for precision for that value were exceeded. X_RNG indicates that the value is outside the range of standards or calibration. S_COMP indicates that the sample composition was unlike the rest for this analyte.
Column_or_Row_Long_Name: Dissolved ferrous iron concentration quality flag
